messages:
maya: FYI we got another batch of partial responses this morning around 09:12 UTC. trace IDs attached in the incident doc. Looks like a client-side stall + aggressive server throttle combo.
kevin: seen it. quick triage: some sessions hit our 30s idle window then client tried to resume but got 503 fragments. stack traces point at session-mgr backpressure.
sarah: looping in @anton for reconnect/backoff logic changes. can we get owners for the short/med/long fixes?
anton: i can own the short-term: increase idle grace from 30s -> 90s for the affected tenant group, push config today, and monitor. ETA end of day. :white_check_mark:
kevin: i'll take the medium-term: add jittered exponential backoff in client SDKs and add server-side circuit breaker to reject bad resumptions earlier. estimate 2 sprints.
maya: long-term i want a replay-safe resume flow and stronger observability around per-session KV cache misses. @kevin @anton please add specific telemetry points.
kevin: note: prioritize telemetry that shows last-successful-keystream, resume_attempt_count, and time_since_last_token. small sample payload in case it helps: 
```
name: session_resume_attempt
tags: [model, tenant]
fields: {
  resume_attempt_count: int,
  last_success_token_ts: iso8601,
  kv_cache_hit: bool
}
```
sarah: action items consolidated: 1) increase idle grace (owner: anton, due: today EOD) 2) client backoff + SDK update (owner: kevin, due: sprint end) 3) telemetry & alert (owner: kevin, due: 3 days) 4) replay-safe resume design doc (owner: maya, due: 2 weeks) 5) post-deploy smoke (owner: anton, due: after config deploy).
maya: tagging expected risk: increasing grace may raise memory pressure on busy nodes. anton please coordinate with eng-infra on canary config.
anton: already talked to infra, will canary on 2 low-traffic clusters first and watch OOM/queue-metrics. will post results in this thread.
incident-bot: reminder: link incident task created -> https://board.redwood/INC-4897, automations added.
kevin: quick perf note — we should also surface a per-route 'stall rate' metric in Console so product teams see regressions. filing followup.
maya: recurring pattern observation: every 6-8 weeks we see a partial-response cluster tied to tenant bursts + small batch sizes. suggestion: add a quarterly retrospective item to map tenant burst profiles to batching policy. owner: maya, due: next retro.
sarah: can we get a minimal rollback plan if the grace increase spikes memory? anton: rollback plan: revert config on canary, auto-scale + reclaim stale sessions, and temporarily throttle new connections to tiered capacity. will document steps and run a drill.
maya: thanks all — i'll update the postmortem followup sheet with these owners/timestamps. please react with :thumbsup: when you accept ownership.
kevin: :thumbsup:
anton: :thumbsup:
sarah: :thumbsup:
